tiebreak_notes: AFC South (TEN vs IND, both 11-5): 'Tennessee finished ahead of Indianapolis in the AFC South based on division record.' (TEN 5-1, IND 4-2)

AFC wild cards, three-way tie at 11-5 (BAL, CLE, IND): 'Baltimore claimed the No. 5 seed over Indianapolis based on head-to-head victory. Division tiebreaker used to eliminate Cleveland' / 'Baltimore claimed the No. 5 seed over Cleveland based on head-to-head sweep.' / 'Cleveland claimed the No. 6 seed over Indianapolis based on head-to-head victory.' MIA (10-6) missed on record, not a tiebreak.
NFC No. 2 seed (NO vs SEA, both 12-4): 'New Orleans finished ahead of Seattle based on conference record.' (NO 10-2, SEA 9-3)

NFC No. 7 seed (CHI vs ARI, both 8-8): 'Chicago finished and clinched the 7th and final playoff spot ahead of Arizona based on better win percentage in common games' (CHI 3-2, ARI 1-4 vs DET, NYG, CAR, LAR). [The 2020-21 NFL playoffs Wikipedia page also says the Bears advanced on common opponents.]
Name note: Washington played 2020 as the 'Washington Football Team'; NFL.com's standings page now labels the row 'Washington Commanders'.
